title: v1_139 / Notable fixes
content:
## Notable fixes

* For users whose organization disables Agent mode by account policy, ensure the Welcome invitation opening is hidden and that alternative methods of launching the disabled Agents Window (for example, `code --agents` disallow circumvention of the control). _[#336968: Fix account policy enforcement in the Agents window](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/336968)_

* For users with enterprise-managed [OpenTelemetry (OTel) settings](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings#configure-telemetry-export-with-opentelemetry), fix a race condition in the configuration of OTel in the Local (i.e. non-Agent Host Harness) to ensure OTel is not dropped. _[#336701: Fix Enterprise Managed OTel Race in Copilot Extension](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/336701)_
